clue.text: Second course perhaps that will revive you

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a ... course, a further course of training taken to update skills
second meaning: a refreshing drink or thing that perks you up

explanation.walkthrough: The 'course' looks like part of a meal, but it is a training course you take a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: A refresher is both a follow-up training course and something, often a drink, that restores your energy.

clue.text: Come round again about dog

parts.note: re means about or concerning
a cur is a mongrel dog

explanation.surface: A dog keeps circling back around something.
explanation.definitionFit: To recur is to happen again, to come back around as a repeated event.

clue.text: Florence endlessly frenzied going to pieces

indicators.note: falling apart signals that the remaining letters are broken up and rearranged
without its end, so the final letter of frenzied is cut off

explanation.surface: Someone in Florence loses their composure in a frenzy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' leaves FRENZIE, and 'going to pieces' rearranges it.
explanation.definitionFit: Firenze is the Italian name for the city that English speakers call Florence.

clue.text: Poor Rex accepted payment for the funds

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in, or accept, the payment within them
poor suggests a battered state, so the letters of Rex are rearranged

parts.note: a cheque is a written order of payment

explanation.surface: Penniless Rex takes a cheque to pay into a fund.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' looks like a description of Rex's finances, but it is the signal to rearrange his name.
explanation.definitionFit: The Exchequer is the British government's treasury, and the word is also used for a person's or body's money supply.

clue.text: Possesses hat, one held by lady coming or going to see you tomorrow

parts.note: has means possesses
a tam, or tam-o'-shanter, is a Scottish woollen hat

indicators.note: the single letter is held inside the name
the name reads the same whether you come at it forwards or go at it backwards

parts.note: Anna is a woman's name
a means one

explanation.surface: A woman with a hat bids someone farewell until the next day.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held by' puts A inside ANNA to give ANANA. The phrase is Spanish, literally 'until tomorrow', and is used in English as a casual goodbye.
explanation.definitionFit: Hasta manana is a Spanish farewell meaning until tomorrow, so it is said as see you tomorrow.

clue.text: Not altered from its natural state, this deal is harsh inequitable treatment

definitions.text: Not altered from its natural state
this deal is harsh inequitable treatment
definitions.meaning: second meaning: the word that makes 'deal' into a ... deal, an unfair treatment

explanation.walkthrough: The second half asks for the word that, put before 'deal', gives the phrase for being treated unfairly.
explanation.definitionFit: Raw describes food or material left unprocessed, and a raw deal is an idiom for unfair treatment.

clue.text: Imitate operatic heroine Charlie

parts.note: Mimi is the heroine of Puccini's opera La Boheme
Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A singer copies the role of an opera heroine for Charlie.
explanation.definitionFit: To mimic someone is to copy their manner or voice, a direct synonym.

clue.text: With no end of anger, endlessly complain about one of the fair sex

indicators.note: the shortened complaint goes around the shortened anger
without its end, so the final letter of the complaint word goes

parts.note: to moan is to complain

indicators.note: the anger word loses its last letter

parts.note: ire means anger

explanation.surface: A woman grumbles endlessly, though her anger has subsided.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one of the fair sex' only asks for any woman, so the answer is a woman's given name.
explanation.definitionFit: Moira is a woman's given name, and the fair sex is an old phrase for women.

clue.text: Composers coming from West Way, Rhode Island

parts.note: Mae West was the American film star
St is the abbreviation for street, a way
RI is the postal abbreviation for the US state of Rhode Island

explanation.surface: Composers live along a road called West Way in Rhode Island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'West' looks like a direction for the road; it is Mae West, the Hollywood actress.
explanation.definitionFit: Maestri is the Italian plural of maestro, a master musician such as a great composer or conductor.

clue.text: Forger attempts to do it and break it

definitions.text: Forger attempts to do it and break it

parts.words: Forger attempts to do it and break it
parts.note: a forger tries to reproduce a work exactly, and in doing so infringes the legal protection of the original

explanation.walkthrough: Split it as two words: the forger tries to copy right, getting the copy accurate, and in doing so breaks the law protecting the original work.
explanation.definitionFit: Copyright is the legal right protecting an author's work from being reproduced by others.

clue.text: From Accra, travelled to a southern South American city

indicators.note: letters that have travelled have moved about, so the city name is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone flew from Accra in Ghana to a city in South America.
explanation.walkthrough: Accra is the capital of Ghana, here only fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Caracas is the capital city of Venezuela, in South America.

clue.text: Review reportedly correct at university

indicators.note: as reported in speech, the word for correct is said aloud and stands for a word sounding the same

parts.note: right means correct
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A newspaper report says a student review was accurate.
explanation.definitionFit: A write-up is a published account or critique of something, such as a play, so a review.

clue.text: Get up about noon and wash

indicators.note: the getting-up word goes around the letter for noon

parts.note: to rise is to get up

explanation.surface: A late riser gets out of bed around midday and has a wash.
explanation.definitionFit: To rinse is to wash with clean water, a close synonym.

clue.text: Rock, a workroom bloomer

parts.note: a lab, or laboratory, is a workroom for experiments
an aster is a flower, something that blooms

explanation.surface: A workshop makes a blunder involving some rock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' looks like a blunder, but here it is a flower, something that blooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Alabaster is a fine-grained mineral, a type of gypsum or calcite stone used for carving.

clue.text: Applicant for job must keep it to stand any chance of getting it

definitions.text: Applicant for job must keep it to stand any chance of getting it

parts.words: Applicant for job must keep it to stand any chance of getting it
parts.note: the first 'it' is the interview slot the candidate must attend, the second the post itself

explanation.walkthrough: The one word means both an arranged meeting such as an interview and the job given to someone, so 'it' refers to each sense in turn.
explanation.definitionFit: An appointment is an arranged meeting and also a post or job to which someone is named.

clue.text: Potter's Bar

parts.note: a potter here is a snooker or billiards player who pots balls, and his bar is the stick he uses

explanation.walkthrough: Potters Bar is a town in Hertfordshire, just north of London; read literally, it is the rod belonging to someone who pots balls at snooker.
explanation.definitionFit: A cue is the long tapered stick used to strike the ball in snooker, billiards and pool.

clue.text: Barber's shop where customers are overcharged

definitions.meaning: first meaning: jokingly, a place where hair is clipped
second meaning: a nightclub or bar that fleeces its customers

explanation.walkthrough: The first sense is a playful literal reading of the phrase, a joint where clipping happens.
explanation.definitionFit: A clip joint is slang for an establishment, typically a nightclub, that swindles patrons with inflated prices.

clue.text: From Penang, pilau that is not very attractive

indicators.note: the answer is made from these letters, so the two words are rearranged together

explanation.surface: A rice dish bought in Penang turns out not to look very appetising.
explanation.walkthrough: Penang is a Malaysian island state and pilau a spiced rice dish; together their eleven letters rearrange into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unappealing lacks appeal, meaning it does not attract or please.

clue.text: To a disgusting extent in a dead language

definitions.text: To a disgusting extent in a dead language

parts.words: To a disgusting extent in a dead language
parts.note: the Latin phrase meaning, literally, to the point of sickness

explanation.walkthrough: The dead language is Latin; the phrase literally means to seasickness, and in English means to a tiresome or sickening degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Ad nauseam is Latin for to the point of nausea, used to describe something repeated tediously.

clue.text: It tells how aircraft sometimes fly

definitions.meaning: first meaning: facts or knowledge that tell you something
second meaning: split as two words, ..., flying in an arranged pattern

explanation.walkthrough: The second sense needs the answer split into two words, describing planes flying together in a set pattern.
explanation.definitionFit: Information is knowledge conveyed, and in formation describes aircraft keeping a fixed group arrangement.

clue.text: Was angry that legal scholar inside did not pick up cleanly

indicators.note: the law graduate is placed inside the anger word

parts.note: fumed means was angry
BL is the abbreviation for Bachelor of Law, a law graduate

explanation.surface: A furious lawyer fails to catch something cleanly.
explanation.definitionFit: To fumble a ball is to handle it clumsily and fail to gather it, as in cricket or rugby.

clue.text: Non-drinker takes nothing in, not even this

definitions.text: Non-drinker takes nothing in, not even this

indicators.note: the non-drinker takes the letter into itself
the nothing letter goes inside the non-drinker

parts.note: TT stands for teetotal, a person who drinks no alcohol
O, the figure zero, means nothing

explanation.surface: A teetotaller refuses alcohol entirely, not even the smallest drink.
explanation.walkthrough: As a whole the clue describes the answer: a teetotaller will not have even a small measure of spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: A tot is a small measure of spirits, the minimal drink a teetotaller still refuses.

clue.text: Area of nothing to disappear into?

definitions.text: Area of nothing to disappear into?

parts.words: Area of nothing to disappear into?
parts.note: the idiom says that someone who vanishes completely has disappeared into an empty space

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals a playful reading of the idiom 'vanish into ...' as a literal empty area.
explanation.definitionFit: To vanish into thin air is an idiom for disappearing completely without trace.

clue.text: Bumpy way to get engine going?

definitions.text: Bumpy way to get engine going?

parts.words: Bumpy way to get engine going?
parts.note: starting a car by pushing it and letting the clutch out with a lurch, or by jump leads from another battery

explanation.walkthrough: 'Bumpy' points to the jerky start the vehicle makes when started this way.
explanation.definitionFit: To jump-start a car is to start its engine using jump leads or by push-starting it.

clue.text: Tease you and me over sweetener

indicators.note: over signals turning the combined letters backwards, as in a down clue read upward

parts.note: to rag someone is to tease them
us means you and me

explanation.surface: Someone teases a couple by sweetening a drink.
explanation.walkthrough: RAG then US makes RAGUS, which 'over' turns backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Sugar is the commonest substance added to food or drink to make it sweet.

clue.text: After word of hesitation I take a kayak initially to be Inuit boat

indicators.note: the hesitation word comes first, with what follows placed after it

parts.note: um is a sound of hesitation

indicators.note: initially means take the first letter of kayak

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates, then decides to take a kayak to become an Inuit boater.
explanation.definitionFit: An umiak is a large open skin boat used by Inuit peoples, unlike the one-person kayak.

clue.text: Sprinkle inner contents of bottle

definitions.note: a noun standing for the name Klein, as in a Klein bottle

indicators.note: the contents of the two words are the letters held within them

explanation.surface: Instructions to sprinkle the inner contents out of a bottle.
explanation.walkthrough: A Klein bottle is a mathematical surface with no inside or outside, named after Felix Klein; the setter lets the name stand for the bottle.
explanation.definitionFit: The Klein bottle is the famous one-sided surface in topology, so the surname suggests that bottle.

clue.text: Ale Gill brewed was not allowed

indicators.note: brewing mixes ingredients, so the letters are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A brewer called Gill made ale that was banned.
explanation.definitionFit: Illegal means forbidden by law, so prohibited.

clue.text: Take off at the end, be without resin

indicators.note: remove the final letter of the lacking word

parts.note: to lack something is to be without it

explanation.surface: A puzzling instruction about doing without a resin.
explanation.definitionFit: Lac is a resinous substance secreted by insects, the source of shellac.

clue.text: In hotel Eva tested lift

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters spanning the three words

explanation.surface: Eva checked out the lift in her hotel.
explanation.definitionFit: To elevate is to raise or lift something up.

clue.text: Old royal family rose

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the dynasty that ruled England from 1485 to 1603
second meaning: the ... rose, the red and white heraldic flower

explanation.walkthrough: 'rose' reads like a verb, but it is the noun, the emblem of that dynasty.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tudor dynasty included Henry VIII and Elizabeth I, and its emblem is the Tudor rose.

clue.text: American river crossed by container vessel

indicators.note: the container spans across the other pieces, holding them within

parts.note: a can is a container
the Tamar is the river dividing Devon from Cornwall in England

explanation.surface: An American river is crossed by a container ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'vessel' seems to be the container ship in the scene, but the container is CAN and 'vessel' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A catamaran is a boat with two parallel hulls, a type of sailing vessel.
